General changes: --added a proper login screen before initialising the main menu --history logs have been further improved to ensure consistency across all in-game events --separated the combined Time/Casino achievement section into Time and Casino --renamed the 'PvE Combat Mode' slogan to Random Combat Mode --extended the combat countdown to 45 seconds, with the final 15 seconds now speeding up combat much faster than before --doubled the number of Dice Tokens you get from defeating a boss level --updated hard daily challenges to recognise your five most-classed dice before applying the class up increase, the class up increase has been lowered slightly.

Dice balance: --Electric: ---Health increased from 720 -> 750 ---Chain damage increased from 16 -> 18 ---Talent: Modified Electric chain damage reduced to 14 ----Electric is in a decent spot since its Talent release, but because it only gets true value in Necromancy/Duality random modes, it must be tweaked right away. Health and chain damage were increased to make it feel better to use, while nerfing the talent to compensate for this. --Ice: ---Mana charge rate increased from 5 -> 6 ---Slow duration increased from 2 turns -> 3 turns ----We liked the mana charge rate buff on Ice, but unfortunately its slow payoff is still not great enough so shifting the recent buff over to the slow duration so it can halt enemy attacks more reliably. --Sword: Health increased from 880 -> 900 ---Sword gets a small health buff to help keep up with the fast-paced meta. --Spear: Health increased from 900 -> 920 ---Same goes with Spear. This should make it feel a little bit better serving its role as a Bruiser. --Iron: ---Damage reduced from 26 -> 22 ---Crush Armor proportional HP damage increase per Class UP reduced from 0.4% -> 0.3% ----Iron continues to be a problem across every single game mode and event, and it often secures kills on its own which makes it a highly dangerous threat, so reducing those numbers should mean players recover more from the hefty HP loss. --Light: ---Health increased from 500 -> 540 ---Radiant Rally only buffs alliea adjacent to it (from having global range) ----Light Dice has been dictating the meta for a while thanks to its easy-to-use skill, and so we proposed a rework to force players to clump up their dice near Light for the same usual effect. Its health was slightly increased to make up for such a big skill nerf. --Battery: Quick Charge mana gain increase per Class UP increased from 5 -> 8 ---By the time you get C11 Battery, you are already dominating matches with ease thanks to insane skill cycling. Now it shouldn't be as effective anymore, with the +1 bonus now being gated towards C9. --Death: Damage increased from 22 -> 24 ---While Death's Instakill Form is certainly powerful, its basic attack doesn't do enough for the payoff that you're getting, so raising that to a power degree. --Broken Growth: ---Health increased from 700 -> 720 ---Growth chance increased from 50% -> 60% ----Despite the efforts to make Broken Growth viable, its skill is just fundamentally flawed as it is now. First things off, matching its health pool to normal Growth allows for competition, while making its growth method more reliable than ever. --Meteor: ---Damage increased from 18 -> 20 ---Talent: Triple Strike mana charge rate increased from 10 -> 12 ----Meteor Dice saw a hot landing ever since its talent got released, but unfortunately without it, Meteor still remains easy to counter, so that's why we upped its basic attack quite a fair margin. Its talent now requires a bit more patience before popping off. --Soul: Health decreased from 640 -> 600 ---Soul has been a powerhouse in many different situations, working best in Skull decks as a long-ranged scaler. Reducing its health pool should make it easier for foes to respond back, plus allows a well-initiated Nuclear blast to fully take it out unscaled.

Boss balance: --Deucifer: ---Hell's Siphon healing rate increased from 50% -> 75% ---Rise From Hell mana charge rate reduced from 14 -> 13 ----Our good old fiend, Deucifer wasn't putting the pressure onto his players enough, so his skills has been adjusted. --Basilisk: ---Distorting Appearance avoid attack chance reduced from 30% -> 25% ---Distorting Appearance avoid attack chance per level reduced from 3% -> 2% ----Many players struggle to keep up with Basilisk and would prefer to run a long-range strategy capable of outranging the effect, so we have adjusted this so players can succeed more often with close/mid range dice.

Mode changes: --Dice Card: Giant Hunter effectiveness vs. bosses reduced from 50% -> 25% ---With Dungeons being able to occasionally use Random Mode modifiers (i.e. Combanity), the 'Giant Hunter' dice card has been adjusted so it cannot dominate bossfights easily.

Bug fixes: --resolved an issue where the daily freebie could keep reappearing after refreshing offers or maxing out a dice offer --main menu tabs should disallow accidental clicks while a menu modal is open --casino chip freebies no longer get treated like the infinitely purchasable chip bundles --fixed clunky Dice Catalogue loadout-slot clicks being intercepted by owned dice cards --fixed stale rolling animation while achieving a Five-of-a-kind through re-rolls in a Fives casino table --Time Die's talent description should correctly display -2 attack counts instead of -1 --resolved an issue that could occur when keeping dice in your hand while your board was full --resolved some bloated interactions with bosses, resulting in assassins going inside their personal space or causing misdirected targeting of many dice --resolved some intricacies with daily challenge class-up application

Dice balance: --Discharge: status effect stacks (such as poison) now account for the passive damage boost ---This was intentionally stripped out when we designed Discharge Dice, but have some fun with the new stack-tactular Discharge!

Bug fixes: --resolved an issue in Deucifer's Challenge that caused Deucifer to refuse to haunt your party at Hallo'ween Night --resolved some issues with boss footprint targeting --shielded dice should correctly record the amount of damage dealt by an attack in history logs --resolved specific multiplayer issues regarding security exploits on the Rivalis framework --resolved an issue that prevented new players from having starter resources --resolved specific edge cases related to the development build

New features: --Added dice talents: every die can now awaken a signature talent that changes how it works during fights --one talent slot per die, and swapping or unequipping is always free, so experimenting never costs you --unlock a talent with Dice Tokens, catch it as a lucky daily Shop offer, or hunt it down inside Diamond and Master chests, where the drop odds scale with the die's rarity --the rarer the die, the rarer the talent, making higher rarities a genuine chase --talents only awaken once you truly own the die and have classed it up to the level the talent demands, so your strongest dice reveal their potential first --a talent can sharpen a die's stats, retune its skills, or grant it something entirely new --Electric, Wind, Light, Meteor and Time Dice starts off with their new obtainable talents!

General changes: --history log improvements: ---damage logs now label whether an attack or skill has dealt critical damage (same applies for healing) ---defeated dice are now written in a separate log instead of being recorded in the damage path to avoid confusion ---Meteor & Judgment Dice skills can finally keep track of how many enemy dice have been hit by their meteor/hammer ---certain skill effects no longer assume that it was cast by a boss die (Deucifer cursed our loggings once again!)

Dice balance: --Iron: Skill proportional damage reduced from 14% -> 12% ---Iron Dice is quite oppressive as an anti-tank option, being able to shred even low-health units fairly quickly alongside team member, so the passive proportional damage has been lowered. --Solitude: Passive proportional max HP damage reduced from 8% -> 7% ---Much like Iron, Solitude is an auto-include in every staple deck that Iron normally thrives in, and with the duo being so strong especially in bossfights, as the passive reduction wasn't much of a downside to be able to do so much damage quickly, so it has been toned down to give players a fair chance.

Bug fixes: --resolved weird jankiness that could go possibly wrong with some transformed effects --resolved an issue that caused Shield Die's shield active to last 1 less turn than intended --resolved an issue that caused multi-hit attacks to not trigger on-damaged effects multiple times (e.g. Wind's Gale Force vs. Armor's Heavy Plating) --resolved an issue that caused bosses to be locked by Lock Dice --resolved an issue that caused some skills to bypass the taunt effect of Shield Dice --resolved some weird targeting behaviour caused by electric chains --resolved an issue that caused critical healing to not correctly apply --multi-projectile attack buffs now correctly label as 'Projectile Count' instead of 'Attack Count'

Security: --hardened the random generator's fallback path so reward, shop, and combat rolls are mixed and no longer directly predictable when a browser does not expose Web Crypto, and a warning is logged when this degraded mode is active

Security: --hardened local save integrity so edited or corrupted save data is rejected and reset to safe defaults --hardened multiplayer turn handling so the server's authoritative battle state is validated before it is applied --closed a case where the playtest/dev menu could ship inside a production build
Bug fixes: --fixed a crash when a save file contained a malformed dice-progress entry

Dice balance: --Fire: Damage increased from 24 -> 26 --Fire: Splash damage increased from 12 -> 13 ---A small buff to Fire's damage output to make it feel more impactful early on. --Ice: Mana charge rate reduced from 6 -> 5 ---Ice is struggling in the current meta due to its low value, so allowing it to get freezes more frequently to bolster its viability as a control option. --Sword: Health increased from 850 -> 880 ---Sword Die's HP is a little too low for a frontline damage dealer, while also being the only Dice that has no direct skills, so it has eaten enough healthy food to sustain more in battle. --Drizzle: Health reduced from 560 -> 540 ---A small HP nerf so Drizzle can be answered more often by mid-range units. --Spear: Health increased from 880 -> 900 ---Much like Sword, Spear needs just a little more to survive the frontline as a bruiser. --Discharge: Damage increased from 25 -> 28 --Discharge's skill is often hard to get value out of and is generally awkward in a lot of situations, so we're upping its basic attack damage. --Slingshot: Health reduced from 480 -> 450 ---Slingshot is still a polarising Dice that can quickly shred low-health units with ease, so it needs some added counterplay --Broken Growth: Damage increased from 28 -> 30 ---Broken Growth Die's major downside is being able to downgrade its attack count to lower its overall damage it can deal per turn, so it needs a little more love --Reverse: Damage increased from 20 -> 22 --Reverse: Health increased from 600 -> 620 ---Reverse is fun to use with a lot of creative decks, but it just lacked sufficient stats on its own, so increasing its stats so it can hold on for a bit longer --Druid: Bear Form: Health decreased from 1,500 -> 1,400 ---The Bear was quite tanky for the opponents to deal with after finishing supporting its team, so lowering that so the opponents have a better chance at mauling it down. --Transcendence: Transformed beam damage reduced from 600 -> 520 ---It never really make sense as to why the Transcendence is truly capable of sniping enemy Dice with such an incredibly powerful attack, so lowering that to a more appropriate balance point.
